## Configurable Xray VPN ports

- New nodes keep random ports for both transports by default.
- Users can use TCP 443 for Vision with a random XHTTP port.
- Users can use TCP 443 for XHTTP with a random Vision port.
- Users can enter both Xray VPN ports manually.
- Manual ports must be different and must not overlap the generated SSH port.
- Existing nodes keep their current ports and are not changed automatically.
